# Nyladic Labs

> A small engineering studio in Bengaluru, India, founded in 2026. We build AI products, and make sure they work.

AI can write software in minutes. Making sure it works still takes care, and that's the part we don't skip.

## Products

- Tabstop: pick up where you stopped with AI coding agents. A local record of your Claude Code and Codex sessions. Live soon, open source under Apache-2.0.
- More tools, built the same way, are in development. We share each one on https://nyladic.com when it is ready.

## What we do

- AI products: our own, starting with Tabstop.
- AI agents: software that does real work and keeps a record of what it did.
- Small tools: experiments we build, test and share for free.

## How we work

- Proof over promises: if we say it works, we can show you why.
- A human decides: AI does the work, and a human signs off on what ships.
- Open where we can: what we can share, we open-source.
